newsitem.title: LATVIA: AIR BALTIC TO REVEAL BIDDERS FOR HOTEL.
newsitem.headline: AIR BALTIC TO REVEAL BIDDERS FOR HOTEL.

text.p: Air Baltic, Latvia's national airline, said on Tuesday it would announce the list of bidders for its Ridzene Hotel at a general meeting of its members on March 20 to March 21.
"After looking through the offers, the members will decide on the course of future action," the company said in a statement.
Air Baltic, 51 percent owned by the government and with a large stake held by Scandinavian Airlines, decided to put the Ridzene up for sale with an offer deadline of March 14.
The formerly state-owned Ridzene, worth $2.25 million, was passed over to Air Baltic to increase the statutory capital of the carrier earlier this year.
